summary: Iteration 3 verified multi-town access feature (extra_town_ids) end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass — /api/towns lists both THS and BHD; surveyor1 login returns accessible_towns=[THS, BHD]; surveyor1 with X-Town-Code:BHD calls /api/auth/me and /api/map/employee-properties successfully (200); surveyor2 correctly denied BHD; admin GET /api/admin/users X-Town-Code:BHD now lists surveyor1; PUT /api/admin/users/{id} with extra_town_ids persists and does NOT change assigned_town (THS untouched); regression admin THS flow still works; POST /api/admin/assign-bulk {area:'BHD Colony 0', employee_ids:[surveyor1]} X-Town-Code:BHD returns success message. Frontend: admin login -> select Thanesar -> /admin/employees shows surveyor1 row; Edit dialog contains 'Additional town access' section (data-testid=edit-town-access-section) with both Thanesar(THS) and थानेसर BHD(BHD) checkboxes; BHD checkbox is pre-checked reflecting persisted grant; toggling+Save Changes -> reopen shows persistence. Add Employee dialog also shows the same section (data-testid=create-town-access-section) with both town checkboxes. Regression: /admin/properties bulk-assign dialog still lists 9 area options including colonies (Didar Nagar, Kirti Nagar, Masita House, Sector 5, Seed Colony, Ward 1, ZZZ_UnknownColony, plus wards 4, 99). Surveyor1 login on /login -> /select-town shows both Thanesar and थानेसर BHD cards -> selecting BHD lands on PHED Dashboard with 5 properties for BHD, no 403 errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Employee action buttons (edit/reset-pin/delete) in /admin/employees table lack data-testid attributes — makes automated selection brittle. Consider edit-employee-<username>, reset-pin-<username>, delete-employee-<username>.
Login form inputs lack data-testid (username-input, password-input, login-submit). Tests currently rely on placeholder text.
backend/server.py still very large; consider splitting admin/users, towns, and map endpoints into modules.
